Unlike Califf's second confirmation in 2022—which suffered from prolonged delays due to bipartisan resistance over opioid policies—Overton's profile engages a highly motivated legislative caucus looking for immediate institutional disruption rather than status-quo administration, bypassing the traditional protracted scrutiny.
